description.value: Small Block Brewery is a craft brewery in the Cowichan Valley near Duncan, BC, producing small-batch hand-crafted British Ales with locally sourced BC ingredients. The taproom has a cozy 'garage' atmosphere where visitors can enjoy tasters or pints, or take home a growler. Wood-fired pizza from Vancouver Island Pizza is available on weekends alongside snacks, making it a worthwhile stop on the Cowichan Valley cycling corridor.
